name: Exact Finite-Size Spectral Moment Benchmarks for Random Two-Dimensional Causal Orders
description: This research note presents exact finite-size spectral moment benchmarks for random two-dimensional causal orders generated by uniform permutations, equivalently by fixed-cardinality uniform sprinklings into a flat 1+1-dimensional causal diamond. For the Hermitian matrix B = i(C − Cᵀ)/N, where C records all strict causal relations, the note provides exact expectations of the second, fourth, sixth and eighth trace moments, together with the exact variance of the fourth moment. A finite-support argument establishes that each unnormalized moment is a polynomial in the number of points. The fourth moment is derived analytically; higher-order coefficients and the variance are obtained through reproducible integer and rational enumeration. The formulas are independently checked against all 362,880 permutations at N = 9. The fourth-moment variance also supplies conservative sampling tolerances through Chebyshev’s inequality. These results offer reference checks for causal-order samplers, matrix normalizations and numerical spectral calculations. The methods use established combinatorial techniques. No priority claim, new physical dynamics or quantum computational advantage is asserted. The results apply specifically to the stated unweighted, flat two-dimensional ensemble. Developed with AI assistance. This independent research note has not undergone peer review.
